no_daw.message: The audio engine is not answering, so where this passage was recorded cannot be read. Check that it is open, then try again.

no_words.message: That passage is not in the chapter's last recording check, so where it was recorded is not known.

not_in_project.message: Part of this passage was cut, trimmed or muted in the project, so there is no single spot to record over. Place the cursor yourself and record from there.

several_voices.message: This passage was recorded on more than one voice track, so there is no single track to record over. Pick the line on one voice, or place the cursor yourself.

stale.message: The recording or the text has changed since the chapter was last checked, so where this passage was recorded is not known. Run the recording check in Proof again.
